title: Can an LLM Fix a Language Model Without Training It?
abstract: arXiv:2611.25613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Although an external language model can select and test repairs to another model's weights, behavior can also be recovered through fixed numerical edits. We assessed the value of interactive selection in a controlled study of Transformer repair. After inspecting predictions, activation summaries, and weight statistics, the editor selects projection recipes to apply to the target without gradient updates. We analyzed 20 recorded sessions involving five masked and causal language models, comparing the selected edits with fixed projections, scripted and matched-budget black-box search, and low-rank adaptation. Under the core two-layer fault, live selection matches black-box search on SmolLM2 and Qwen2.5. For Pythia, live selection achieves 65.62% completion accuracy, compared with 0% for black-box search and 66.15% for a fixed projection. Under a separate compound fault affecting attention and feed-forward weights, both scripted and LLM-gui

translated_title: LLM能在不训练的情况下修复语言模型吗？
translated_abstract: 尽管外部语言模型可以选择并测试对另一个模型权重的修复，但模型行为也可以通过固定的数值编辑来恢复。我们在一项Transformer修复的对照研究中评估了交互式选择的价值。在检查预测结果、激活摘要和权重统计之后，编辑者（LLM）选择要应用于目标模型的投影配方，而无需任何梯度更新。我们分析了涉及五个掩码语言模型和因果语言模型的20个记录会话，将LLM所选的编辑与固定投影、脚本化及等预算的黑盒搜索以及低秩适配进行了比较。在核心的双层故障下，实时选择在SmolLM2和Qwen2.5上的表现与黑盒搜索相当。对于Pythia，实时选择达到了65.62%的补全准确率，而黑盒搜索为0%，固定投影为66.15%。在另一个同时影响注意力和前馈权重的复合故障下，脚本化和LLM引导的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 研究表明，LLM无需任何梯度训练，仅通过交互式检查模型预测、激活和权重统计并选择数值投影编辑，即可有效修复受损的Transformer语言模型，其表现可与黑盒搜索相当甚至大幅超越（如Pythia上达到65.62%准确率而黑盒搜索为0%）。
